# Single worker execution consolidation — proposed PLAN

## Standing, scope and decision

Proposal for conductor comparison and independent admission, measured against 18569a41192405663b4af01109e4d91c4bddd527, base c06ed9442ba51c9e96aa8de9f9bde93d0843a6cc. This artifact is content in the authorized envelope; it is not a file path or an admitted implementation contract.

The updated owner ruling controls: independent dev tooling remains under ops/ permanently. No Symfony application dependency, application service replacement, prod-lane retirement trajectory, new executor, lifecycle database, capability registry or external dependency is proposed. The prod work profile identifies the application being worked on; it does not select the implementation technology of the tools. Historical captures and the earlier Symfony/AI recommendations remain provenance, superseded on this point. Loopstrap supplies research patterns only; neither its code nor dependencies are admitted.

Retain ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py as the authoritative worker execution service, with launch/resume/collect/status/wait/close as its interfaces. Consolidate its existing functions in place; do not put another engine beside it. task retains jobs, rendering requirements, envelopes, filesets, verify and replay. Its vendor-running path becomes a compatibility caller of dispatch after its supported behavior has an accepted destination. Dispatch consumes task domain helpers, never the task compatibility frontend. Harness owns configurable vendor mechanics, isolation descriptions and probe evidence; telemetry owns usage and breaker behavior. The separately scoped lane/lane-boundary-20260905 owns shared policy and enforcement. This track consumes its accepted interface and never implements a substitute policy engine.

## Measured baseline and reconciliation

The supplied independent inventory targets e59a52bce37dbd1fed52d358b655bae00267f71f. Git comparison found no changes since that revision under ops/devlane, ops/bin, ops/conductor/tools, ops/process, .claude/skills/cross-review or docs. Targeted source reads reproduce its important seams. Reuse its inventory and conformance matrix rather than commission another broad audit. Historical execution evidence is not current activation evidence.

| Surface | Evidence/classification | Migration obligation |
|---|---|---|
| launch.py | Execution evidenced by supplied captures; source owns minting, Popen, inline supervision, settlement and recovery | Keep canonical identity, directory layout, whole-history snapshots and collection; move shared mechanics behind existing boundaries without replacing custody |
| ops/bin/dispatch.sh → conductor/tools/dispatch.sh | Wired operator entrypoint | Preserve branch/worktree resolution, configuration precedence, ordered inputs, dry-run, scope limits, explicit launcher pin, foreground/detached operation and early record id |
| go.sh | Wired convenience frontend | Preserve intent expansion and review sequencing; replace unsupported hardcoded harness defaults with explicit/configured selections checked by shared policy |
| ladder.sh / ladder.py | Wired orchestration | Preserve stage custody, follows, accepted-envelope checks and durable ladder resume; harness resume and ladder resume remain different operations |
| task/run.py | Callable manual/parity runner; supplied search found test callers, not production callers | Preserve include/base-derived filesets, direct verify and stub replay. Migrate vendor execution only after snapshot, supervision, output and result compatibility pass; do not claim it is launch.py's current backend |
| Grok lever | Manual/provisionable path; live use unmeasured | Account for archive/subtree scope, arbitrary prompt input, minimal environment, model/permission/output/turn/web dials, timeout and run-record evidence |
| Codex/Fable levers | Manual paths; Fable has fake-harness selftests | Account for synthetic Git baselines, separate write trees, post-run commits, provision-levers and legacy apply-push consumers. Fable's Claude-write behavior conflicts with canonical admission and cannot silently become an admitted capability |
| cross-review recipe and skill | Prescribed manual path, protected by telemetry tests | Replace direct vendor launch, newest-stream selection and separately armed battery with canonical dispatch examples; preserve the review procedure and trip evidence |
| harness/probe.py | Explicit diagnostics; not ordinary worker dispatch | Retain behavioral/structural probe ownership and CLEAN/LEAKING/INVALID semantics. Ordinary worker work cannot use the diagnostic interface to evade policy |
| stage/fileset/verify, fixtures and generic command seams | Helpers, synthetic/direct execution and calibration apparatus | Keep these distinct from vendor workers. stage is not another executor. Generic argv execution is not proof of another production worker path |
| watchdog/monitor/lane_read/MCP; land/apply-push | Observation or evidence consumers | Read existing records; do not take ownership of spawning, supervision, retries or lifecycle state |

The six supplied drift findings become acceptance obligations: actual launch/run ownership; full breaker parity; conflicting selection and permission tables; manual recipe convergence; semantic envelope acceptance; and explicit exit compatibility. They are pre-existing runtime drift, not runtime regressions introduced by this documentation/capture diff.

Additional reconciliation: task/envelope.py rejects multiline or long artifact values and its validate function requires its legacy field ordering and set. The launcher accepts a broader schema, including optional commit metadata. Therefore replacing _schema_valid with an unqualified validate call would break accepted behavior, including this authorized inline PLAN. Shared semantic validation must be parameterized by the declared result contract. Preserve supported commit metadata and transport-independent JSON object semantics; retain strict handle rules for jobs that declare handles. Do not weaken every job merely to accommodate one output mode.

The supplied plan record 20260906T011959Z-plan-codex-976735 reports an invalid result because out/PLAN.md could not be written under the read-only sandbox. jobs.json requires that output, while launch.py has a special writable-out path for check-tests. Treat this as a mismatch between declared output requirements and execution permissions, not a need to make plan a write role.

## Execution boundary and verified couplings

Proposed request fields belong to the existing dispatch/task contracts: job and template digest; immutable ref and lineage; actor and producer identity; harness, explicit model and optional effort; independent work profile and role; selected input digests/follows; snapshot mode and given/withheld declarations; permitted source effects; artifact transport and output paths; scratch requirements; supervision values with sources; and fresh/resume intent. The request is resolved once before launch and its effective values recorded. A frontend may resolve owner-controlled configuration, but adapters must not select a model, role, policy or fallback vendor.

Proposed adapter operations cover fresh/resume argv, prompt transport, hook payload/response translation, MCP connection mechanics, session/stream location, response candidate extraction and observed model/usage extraction. Reuse and extend the existing harness/isolation.py HARNESSES descriptions for declared isolation/capability metadata; move vendor mechanics into harness/adapters.py. Do not retain task.ADAPTERS as a second live vendor table. Measured capabilities remain evidence stamped to executable/version, adapter/configuration digest, date and probe result; declared support is not measured support.

The policy handoff must provide a versioned normalized request/decision contract, configuration ownership, required evidence, refusal classes and adapter enforcement obligations. The target tracked tree contains no lane-policy implementation path. Its owning track must supply the exact accepted import/command path and immutable revision before the policy-join slice runs. Missing policy evidence is a dependency refusal, not permission to create a guessed module. GPT-6 preference and Daybreak's security restriction are owner-configurable selection constraints applied by that owner; no model names are embedded in jobs or execution code.

| Edge | Owner and verification |
|---|---|
| frontends → dispatch | Normalize equivalent requests and compare effective selection, permissions, inputs, caps and canonical result using fake executables |
| dispatch → task | jobs/rendering/output contract and one semantic envelope authority; preserve findings, declared artifacts and commit metadata |
| dispatch → harness | Pure adapter mechanics plus isolated environment; fixture argv, payload and stream tests, then separately authorized live probes |
| dispatch → lane policy | Versioned decision with role/profile/tool/source/output grants; contract-verified mock before counterparty exists; no live activation without accepted counterparty |
| dispatch → stage/fileset | Given present, withheld absent, no history recovery, manifest and diff outside snapshot; positive, negative and unreachable proof |
| dispatch → telemetry | One breaker implementation, bound process group/session, aggregate accounting and durable trip evidence |
| dispatch → record/land | One canonical record, lineage-bound copies and refs, attributable commits, preserved residue and verified collection |
| observers/discovery → record/capabilities | Read projections only, explicit missing/stale evidence; neither MCP surface imports action authority |

Each edge must discharge closure, shape, behavior, freshness, permission and blast-radius obligations from docs/verified-couplings.md. Name its source/test endpoints in the slices below and stamp acceptance to the landed revision. No reference to absent ops/contracts/imports.json counts as a verified edge; document the actual composition edges in the admitted contracts and check them independently.

## Permissions, isolation, supervision and custody

Separate source authority from output authority. Declare envelope-content outputs, file outputs and scratch needs as job data. File paths must resolve within the job's authorized out/ roots, with traversal, symlink and root-alias cases refused. For a source-read job, allowing a document or scratch file does not authorize source edits. The canonical service computes the minimum required grants and asks the adapter/policy boundary to realize them. Unsupported combinations refuse before vendor launch. A sandbox label, chmod or post-run diff check is not a substitute for containment evidence. Record requested, configured and observed protection separately.

The immediate review keeps the current read-only sandbox and inline artifact transport. Later file-output support applies to every job declaring those needs, including plan, check-tests and adjudicate, without a job-name exception. The existing check-tests path must remain covered while the general mechanism is introduced. Where the actual harness cannot protect source while writing authorized output, retain an explicit unsupported-capability refusal; do not broaden host permissions or silently change the requested deliverable.

Whole mode retains detached HEAD, history, no remote/alternates/reflogs/source-path leakage and the existing permitted repository delta. Whole plus withholding refuses. Fileset mode is a separately admitted extension: derive from the named ref, prove given-minus-withheld and withheld absence, exclude .git/history, report noise, place manifest/diff outside the tree and bind inputs/tools to worker custody. A scope string or work-profile label is not a fileset proof. Worker MCP receives only job-authorized data; it does not inherit conductor discovery, credentials, source breadth or tool grants.

Dispatch must call the existing breaker behavior rather than duplicate its predicates. Preserve aggregate output accounting, Grok cumulative updates and resets, repetition/error storms, stall/size limits and their disabled-wire rules. In particular, do not restore the manual recipe's total-token wall: wires.py disables that wire. Record resolved timeout/cap sources. Bind streams to the job/session/cwd and arm supervision across fresh and resumed attempts. Exercise absent stream while alive, fast exit before stream, final accounting, breaker failure, child exit with descendants, cancellation and trip. Watchdog remains a read-only observer of uncertain/dead/settling/closed evidence, not a substitute supervisor.

Keep the job directory's prompt, in/, out/, raw.out, stderr, breaker.log, TRIPPED.md, state.json and exit ownership. Preserve canonical record.json plus the branch .dev/records/dispatches/<id>.json projection, refs/dispatch/<id>, portable paths, input/template/stream digests and requested-versus-observed model attribution. Only the launcher fills measured spend; unavailable measurement remains explicit. Do not move records into a new registry or database.

Resume keeps the same snapshot cwd and bound session, restores only the matching archived store, preserves original authority, appends attempts/output and records authorized cap/reason changes. Foreign paths, missing stores, incompatible adapter/policy versions and simultaneous attempts refuse. Failed resume cannot erase previous evidence. --prompt-file is parsed today but replacement-prompt behavior is not proven; either implement an explicitly authorized, digested amendment contract or refuse the option rather than advertise it as working. A successful write resume does not imply residual collection. collect remains separately verified and idempotent, preserves patches and refuses failed verification without moving the accepted ref/record.

## Refusals and exit compatibility

Use founding outcomes at the consolidated public boundary: 0 completed without findings, 1 completed with findings, 2 rejection before action, 3 abort after action with durable partials. Keep child exit, envelope status, verdict and CLI outcome separate. Acceptance of a terminal envelope is never inferred from child exit zero.

Every rejection names expected, found and needed, emits one stderr line and no stdout. Preserve existing identity, live-target, ref, record-target, stale-base, model, isolation, history-vs-withheld, mode-unavailable, write-role-unadmitted, scope/caps, off-lineage-head, resume-store, collect and verify conditions. Only explicitly overridable conditions accept a recorded reason.

Add contract rows for missing/incompatible policy, unavailable or stale required capability, conflicting protected argv/configuration, unprovable source/output grants, missing given input, unresolved artifact transport, incompatible resume and unsupported legacy behavior. Example: output-permission: expected source-read with writable declared out/PLAN.md; found adapter cannot enforce those roots; needed a verified compatible adapter or an explicitly amended output contract. Example: policy: expected the accepted lane-policy interface and revision; found no admitted counterparty; needed the lane-boundary handoff.

The old launcher, task CLI, shell levers, isolation shell interface and wait command have different exit meanings. Inventory these translations in the contract and test each caller; never globally reinterpret every numeric 3 or 64. Migrate callers together with their wire expectations, preserving explicitly documented compatibility behavior until the corresponding caller slice lands. Extend the existing conductor conformance registry/gate to allowlisted repository endpoints; it remains a conformance registry, not an execution registry. Preserve unknown/dead/invalid distinctions in wait and ladder when changing mappings.

## First-run walkthrough and assumption rule

1. Conductor selects one admitted slice, an owned branch based on dev and explicit harness/model/effort. Supply contract, scope and authorized evidence through dispatch.sh inputs. A stale ref, protected branch, missing identity, unavailable launcher pin or unsupported selection refuses before minting. Nothing in this review launches that run.
2. The launcher mints the isolated job layout. Resolve tools against that actual snapshot: vendor/, vendor/bin/mate and packages/wire are absent here, so PHP application tooling is not a prerequisite or fallback. Python/Git and lane apparatus availability are checked in the later execution environment. Missing executable refuses; no download, Composer install, host settings or network repair is implicit.
3. An independent test author receives the admitted contract and authorized interfaces, with implementation/corpus withholding actually proved where required. Whole-history mode cannot claim that firewall. The test-author job may write its declared test outputs; the skeptic needs declared document/scratch authority. Until generalized output permission is admitted, use an explicitly authorized inline review envelope for skepticism rather than repeating the PLAN.md failure.
4. Test commands needing temporary repositories or writable .git run only in a writable isolated test fixture supplied by the authorized test job/runner. This review's read-only Git directory is not a suitable integration-test workspace. Source-read jobs do not improvise chmod, host paths or permission escalation.
5. A distinct implementation producer receives the accepted tests and only its source-file grant. It neither changes nor approves the tests. A distinct reviewer evaluates the final tree and evidence. Red test artifacts may be retained on their producing branch/record; they do not land alone on dev as a knowingly red slice.
6. Collection verifies the produced tree, attribution, residue and allowed paths. The self-hosted CI workspace uses its own isolated writable fixture directories and fake vendor tools, with no operator homes or real model launches. Run ops/bin/suites.sh there; missing configuration/tooling or unavailable checks is recorded as refusal/unreachable, never green. The operator alone performs standing/merge transitions.

Every assumption must be measured at dispatch against its ref/environment or have a named refusal at the point it would be used. This rule applies to this plan. Estimates below are proposals, not measurements. Physical lane-policy placement, live harness containment and external/manual callers remain unresolved; none is silently assumed available.

Use the supplied inventory's exact existing test matrix as the regression floor. Relevant files include dispatch/tests/test_launch_snapshot.py, test_launch_refusals.py, test_launch_isolation.py, test_launch_skeptic_write.py, test_launch_job_caps.py, test_launch_watch.py, test_launch_collect.py, test_launch_prompt_feed_findings.py, test_launch_review_p1_findings.py, test_launch_record.py, test_record_paths.py, test_launch_record_copy.py and the envelope test_launch_* suites; harness/tests/test_isolation.py, test_isolation_contract.py, test_probe.py and test_probe_contract.py; task/tests/test_envelope.py, test_envelope_schema.py, test_fileset.py and test_run.py; telemetry/tests/test_breaker.py, test_breaker_grok.py and test_wiring.py; conductor/tests/test_dispatch_wrapper.py, test_ladder_lever.py, test_land_lever.py, test_monitor.py and test_watchdog*.py.

Additional cases are requirements for independent authors, not tests authored here: identical normalized requests through each frontend; declared output granted with source and unrelated paths denied; inline PLAN accepted only under its declared transport; optional commit retained; counts/status inconsistencies rejected without discarding findings; cumulative rather than per-message cap enforcement; resume authority and evidence preservation; staging proved against Git-history and path escapes; legacy lever output/commit equivalence; and refusal-wire coverage of every migrated endpoint. Positive controls must accompany planted faults, and unreachable probe arms cannot pass.

Existing test_envelope.py ran here: 31 passed. Its passing handle restrictions demonstrate the migration compatibility issue; they do not certify the proposed contract. All other test references are source/inventory evidence unless explicitly stated otherwise. New test paths below are proposed. Their predicted red reasons are named in the slice table; no unexecuted red or green result is claimed.

Retire each vendor launch implementation only when its supported behavior has a passing canonical witness or an explicit owner-admitted retirement with a tested refusal/remedy. Preserve raw legacy records and apply-push compatibility for historical evidence. Do not infer global non-use from an empty source search. A stale provisioned lever must converge or refuse; it cannot remain an undocumented escape. Probe/direct/replay execution remains explicitly classified apparatus, with no ordinary worker bypass. No runtime slice is admitted on documentation alone.

## Slices, dependencies, ownership and green landing

Bucket rule: S means 1–3 changed files and one implementation worker run estimated below ten minutes. M requires exactly two named S buckets and 4–8 files; larger work splits. All proposed slices below are S. If an author cannot meet the stated file/time bound, return a re-bucketing proposal before expanding the grant. Repeated paths are serialized. File grants are the machine lines at the end; no unlisted file is implicitly writable.

For every runtime slice: T-id independently authors/tests the specified acceptance; K-id independently reviews those tests; I-id implements only source; R-id independently reviews the result. The implementation producer never writes or approves its tests. Contract/document slices use a contract producer and independent reviewer. Conductor assigns distinct sessions and explicit models through dispatch; this planner neither approves nor dispatches them. Each landed slice includes the accepted test and implementation commits, preserves the existing floor, and passes ops/bin/suites.sh. Contract, dispatcher and argv changes each receive their own reviewable PR; the small convenience/document slices may follow in separately green PRs. Draft-first and stationary-lineage rules apply.
